headerDisplay: Talks to a locally-paired AmpScm/TadoLocal instance — not Tado's cloud. Confirm host/port/token against the running instance's own /docs page first.

host.title: TadoLocal Host
host.description: IP/hostname of the TadoLocal REST API — the Docker host, not the bridge itself.

port.title: TadoLocal Port
port.description: Per upstream's own README ("Base URL: http://localhost:4407"). A separate HACS integration's docs claim 8000 as their own default — confirm against your instance's actual /docs before trusting either.

bearerToken.title: Bearer Token
bearerToken.description: Generated by TadoLocal itself — check its startup logs or Setup & Debug UI for where it's surfaced.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Fallback Poll Interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Safety net only — GET /events (SSE) drives most updates.
